subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw add persisted compaction trigger metadata and require last-call/context snapshot proof before successful-turn overflow compaction on yielded parent wakes?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses compaction policy, provider usage semantics, persisted transcript fields, and live subagent-yield behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent schema or fallback policy alone.

options.title: Add Trigger Metadata And Guard Fallback
options.body: Persist a closed compaction trigger/cause field, make successful-turn overflow require trustworthy context or last-call usage, and validate the subagent-yield wake path live.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer reproduces the current-main parent-wake compaction path with live logs and transcript artifacts.

recommendation.title: Add Trigger Metadata And Guard Fallback
recommendation.body: Persist a closed compaction trigger/cause field, make successful-turn overflow require trustworthy context or last-call usage, and validate the subagent-yield wake path live.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to earlier session usage-accounting hardening among the identified current-history candidates.
